cow.summary: The model is a four-legged chibi cow with gold horns, black patches, and a pink muzzle. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the bell, the fur, and the tail are clearly different.
strengths: The gold horns, the pink ears, and the large pink muzzle with nostrils match the mockup.
The black patches on the head and the body read at 128 px in every direction.
The walk clip lifts each hoof and keeps the body level.
issues: The bell hangs under the chin, and the muzzle hides it in the front view. Make the bell larger and move it down onto the chest, as in the mockup.
The whole body has a rough fur texture. The mockup has smooth clay. Reduce the fur bump on the body and the head.
The tail points back and down. The mockup tail curls up at the side with a dark tuft. Bend the tail up.
The eyes are small and sit under heavy brows. The mockup has larger, bright eyes. Increase the eye size and lift the brows.
The side view shows a long snout and eyes that bulge from the sides of the head. Shorten the snout and set the eyes into the face.
The hooves are black and tall. The mockup has short dark grey hooves with a split. Add the pink udder and the white head tuft from the mockup.
cow.next: Move a larger bell down onto the chest so that it reads in the front view and at 128 px.

ox.summary: The model is a dark brown chibi ox with wide cream horns and a rope collar. The horns read well, but the eyes, the color, and the chest patch are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The wide cream horns give a clear silhouette in every sprite direction.
The rope collar matches the mockup.
The walk clip moves the legs in a readable cycle.
issues: The eyes are small dots. The mockup eyes are very large and glossy with large highlights. Make the eyes about twice as large.
The coat is a dark red-brown. The mockup coat is a light caramel tan. Make the coat lighter and warmer.
The cream chest patch is missing. Add the cream patch below the collar.
The bell hangs under the muzzle and the front view hides it. Move the bell down onto the chest.
The muzzle is a dull tan. The mockup muzzle is pink peach. Make the muzzle pinker.
The whole body has a rough fur texture, and the side view shows a long snout with bulging eyes. Make the surface smoother and the snout shorter.
ox.next: Make the eyes much larger and glossier to match the mockup face.

fox.summary: The model is an orange chibi fox with a big tail and a sit clip that matches the mockup pose. The face is noticeably different: the cheek tufts stick out like wings and the muzzle is a broad white mask.
strengths: The sit clip shows the same seated pose as the mockup, with straight front legs.
The orange coat, the dark paws, and the large tail read at 128 px.
The large brown eyes with lashes keep a cute face.
issues: The white cheek tufts stick out from the sides of the head like separate wings. Blend them into the face as a ruff that flares out below the eyes.
The muzzle is a broad, smooth white mask with a long mouth line. The mockup has a small muzzle with a small mouth. Make the muzzle smaller and add fur texture to it.
The ears have grey-white fur inside and only small black tips. The mockup ears have black edges and black backs. Paint the outer ear edges black.
The eyes have a dark rim that looks like goggles. Remove the dark rim and add large highlights as in the mockup.
The body has a rough fur texture, but the muzzle is smooth. Use one surface treatment on the whole head.
The back view shows a dark band across the head between the ears. Limit the black paint to the ears.
fox.next: Blend the cheek tufts into the face and make the white muzzle smaller.

wolf.summary: The model is a grey chibi wolf with a cream muzzle and brown paws. It is the same animal, but the face, the tail pose, and the leg length are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The cream muzzle, the black nose, and the smile line are present.
The tall ears and the brown paws read at 128 px.
The walk clip moves all four legs in a clear cycle.
issues: Heavy grey brows sit low over the eyes and make the face look stern. The mockup face is open and happy. Remove or lift the brows.
The head is a round ball. The mockup head has wide cheeks and a wide cream smile area. Widen the cheeks and the cream area.
The tail points up and back like a flag. The mockup tail hangs low with a dark tuft. Lower the tail.
The legs are short and thick. The mockup legs are long and slim. Make the legs longer.
The coat is dark charcoal grey. The mockup coat is a light blue-grey. Make the coat lighter.
The eyes are smaller than in the mockup, and the cream chest bib is faint. Increase the eye size and paint a clear chest bib.
wolf.next: Remove the heavy brows and widen the cheeks so that the face reads as happy, as in the mockup.

riding-wolf.summary: The model is a grey chibi wolf with a brown saddle and a teal pad. The saddle reads well, but the face has a sleepy, grumpy expression that the mockup does not have.
strengths: The brown saddle, the teal pad, and the bags read at 128 px in every direction.
The white socks, the black paws, and the head crest match the mockup.
The tail has a white tip, as in the mockup.
issues: Heavy half-closed lids make the face look sleepy and grumpy. The mockup has bright, open eyes and a confident smile. Open the eyes and lift the lids.
The muzzle is a smooth white mask with seams at the cheeks. The mockup has a cream lower face and chest. Paint the lower face cream and remove the seams.
The legs are short. The mockup legs are long, and the wolf stands proud with the chest out. Make the legs longer and lift the head.
The coat is a darker grey than the mockup. Make the coat lighter.
The harness in the mockup has a chest strap with a ring at the front. Make the front strap and the ring larger so that they read.
riding-wolf.next: Open the eyes and remove the heavy lids so that the expression matches the confident mockup face.

badger.summary: The model is a smooth chibi badger with a striped white face, a grey body, and black legs. It is close to the mockup in the front view, but the side view shows a low, long head.
strengths: The striped white face reads at 128 px in every direction.
The smooth clay surface and the grey, white, and black value plan match the mockup.
The large glossy eyes and the small smile give a friendly face.
issues: The head sits low and points forward in line with the back. The mockup head is raised on the neck. Lift the head and tilt it up.
The side view shows a long, pointed snout. The mockup snout is shorter and the head is rounder. Shorten the snout.
The side view shows a hard vertical line between the white head and the grey body. Blend the white cheeks into a cream chest, as in the mockup.
The black stripes stop near the eyes. In the mockup, the stripes run up over the head to the ears. Extend the stripes to the ears.
The chest is pure white. The mockup chest is cream. Warm the chest color.
badger.next: Lift the head on the neck and shorten the snout to match the mockup side silhouette.

moth.summary: The model is a chibi moth with a brown face, knobbed antennae, and dotted wings. The hood covers the whole head like a knit cap, and the wings droop, so the model is clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The brown face with large glossy eyes and an open smile reads at 128 px from the front.
The knobbed antennae and the wing dots read in the sprites.
The fly clip flaps the wings and keeps the body in the air.
issues: The hood is a closed ball with a scale pattern that looks like knitted wool. The mockup has a fluffy mane of fine spiky strands around the face and a tuft on top. Change the hood to spiky fur strands and open the top of the head.
The lower wings droop down and almost touch the ground. The mockup wings spread out level. Lift the lower wings.
The antennae knobs are long ovals on long stalks. The mockup knobs are large round balls on short stalks. Make the knobs rounder and the stalks shorter.
The small arms and legs are hidden. The mockup shows small arms at the sides and small legs under the belly. Add visible arms and legs.
The side view shows only the hood and a wing. Bring the face forward so that the eye reads from the side.
moth.next: Change the scaled hood to a fluffy mane of spiky strands that frames the face.

squirrel.summary: The model is an orange chibi squirrel with a large round tail and tufted ears. The tail reads well, but the face and the body plan are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The large round tail gives a clear squirrel silhouette at 128 px.
The tufted ears and the cream chest match the mockup.
The run clip has a bounding gait that suits the mockup run.
issues: The eyes have wide white rims and look startled. The mockup eyes are brown with highlights and a soft, happy look. Remove the white rims and add a small smile.

The body is long, and the legs are straight and thick like a dog. The mockup has a small body, large hind thighs, and front paws held at the chest. Make the hind thighs larger and the front legs thinner.
The head is small for the body. The mockup head is large. Make the head larger.
A thin seam line crosses the white cheek fur. Remove the seam.
The tail surface is a lumpy noise. The mockup tail has carved swirl strands. Add a swirl pattern to the tail.
squirrel.next: Change the eyes and the mouth to the soft, happy face of the mockup.
